name: Noble Englishmen
description: The Noble Englishmen were a Black street gang active in East Harlem, New York during the 1950s. Their documented rivals included the Python Knights and the Enchanters. A gang-related beating and stabbing of a Noble Englishmen member by a Python Knights member was recorded on November 30, 1956.

sources.title: Profile of a Python Knight, an East Harlem Gang | New York City Fighting Gangs
